title: Stable-Type selectBytes moonshot
impact: Moonshot: Caching each column's first-row SQLite storage class and skipping `sqlite3_column_type()` on later rows exposed a plausible fixed-shape ceiling in `select_bytes_wide_cols.dart` (candidate faster on the wide integer and mixed lanes), but the integer-heavy harness did not reproduce a clean win and the semantic failure is decisive: an untyped column with row 1 INTEGER and row 2 TEXT serialized as `[{"v":1},{"v":0}]` instead of `[{"v":1},{"v":"abc"}]`. Rejected as a hidden default; prototype preserved at `archive/exp-200`.
